member.name: T:Digifact.Fel.BuyerDetails
member.summary:
Identifies the buyer for a DTE document.
Use for anonymous consumer final, for a registered NIT (auto-lookup when only NIT is provided), or for CUI-identified buyers.
Implicit conversion from is supported: "CF" → consumer final, any digit string → NIT with auto-lookup.
